propositions: Test oracle _bounded_bank_gaps measures executed filesystem-tool calls but the policy enforcement boundary is denominated in evidence responses, causing structural mismatch post-dd41

Commit e1352535ace changed policy to execute additional batched evidence calls instead of suppressing them, causing a batching model to achieve 11 executed reads in ≤2 evidence responses instead of distributed execution
The test oracle must be re-denominated to evidence responses (distinct run_steps) to align with the actual enforcement boundary of max_evidence_responses=3
Re-scoped oracle must reject zero-bank exhaustion and first banks occurring after >3 evidence responses, while accepting dd41-intended batched execution pattern
Test-only repair requires moving response-counting wrapper-toolset and bounded-gap oracle to shared _bank_observer.py and adding live-independent unit regression to validate the re-scoped oracle
